articles.title: Keepace.ai: A Technical Report on a Large Language Model for Sports and Health
articles.abstract: Large language models hold promise for delivering safe, scientifically grounded, and personalized exercise guidance at scale, yet the sports-and-health domain still lacks curated training corpora and rigorous evaluation benchmarks. Keepace.ai is a domain-specialized LLM built on Qwen3.5-27B through post-training, currently optimized for Chinese-language exercise guidance across three tasks: workout plan generation, sports-and-health knowledge QA, and personal sports data analysis. In internal rubric-based evaluations designed with domain experts, Keepace.ai outperforms its base model and larger general-purpose baselines, with the most pronounced improvements in exercise safety, boundary compliance, structured output completeness, and scientific accuracy. This report summarizes the current design, data pipeline, safety-first evaluation framework, and evaluation results of Keepace.ai.
articles.titleCn: Keepace.ai：一个用于体育和健康领域的大型语言模型技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型有望大规模提供安全、科学且个性化的运动指导，但运动与健康领域仍缺乏经过精心策划的训练语料库和严格的评估基准。Keepace.ai 是基于 Qwen3.5-27B 通过后训练构建的领域专用大型语言模型，目前针对中文运动指导优化，涵盖三个任务：训练计划生成、运动与健康知识问答以及个人运动数据分析。在由领域专家设计的基于标准的内部评估中，Keepace.ai 表现优于其基础模型和更大规模的通用基线，在运动安全、边界合规性、结构化输出完整性和科学准确性方面均有显著提升。本报告总结了 Keepace.ai 的当前设计、数据管道、安全优先评估框架及评估结果。

articles.title: 3DCodeEdit: Benchmarking Instruction-Guided 3D Program Editing
articles.abstract: Language models increasingly create 3D content through code, with practical workflows often relying on editing existing programs rather than regenerating them, for speed and precise control. Such edits require understanding what a program builds and foreseeing how a change reshapes it, yet prior benchmarks mostly evaluate generation or simple edits against a reference. In this paper, we introduce 3DCodeEdit, a benchmark of 2,592 instruction-guided editing tasks over 108 Blender programs that construct objects entirely in code. Its edits range from parameter to structural changes, style redesign, and scene composition, and are judged from renders against human-reviewed checklists. Across 17 models, the average success rate is only 37%, and even the strongest models complete fewer than 60% of structural and style edits. As models become more capable, their failures shift to geometric foresight, where the code runs but builds the wrong shape. We therefore study whether multi-turn feedback can compensate for this missing foresight. Feedback from a separate reviewer model that describes how the renders differ from the request helps most, more than maximum reasoning effort or an agent harness, and can let a 27B model surpass the single-shot rate of a 2.8T-parameter model.
articles.titleCn: 3DCodeEdit：指令引导式3D程序编辑基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越多地通过代码创建3D内容，而实际工作流程通常依赖于编辑现有程序而非重新生成它们，以实现速度和精确控制。此类编辑需要理解程序构建的内容并预见变更如何重塑它，然而之前的基准测试大多仅评估生成或简单编辑任务与参考内容的对比。在本文中，我们介绍了3DCodeEdit，这是一个包含2592个指令引导编辑任务的基准测试，涵盖108个完全通过代码构建对象的Blender程序。其编辑范围从参数调整到结构变更、风格重设计以及场景构图，并通过渲染结果与人工审核的清单进行评判。在17个模型中，平均成功率仅为37%，即使是性能最强的模型也未能完成超过60%的结构和风格编辑。随着模型能力的提升，它们的失败点逐渐转移到几何预判上，即代码能够运行但构建了错误的形状。因此，我们研究了多轮反馈是否能够弥补这种缺失的预判能力。来自一个独立的评审模型提供的反馈，描述渲染结果与请求之间的差异，效果最为显著，优于最大推理努力或代理工具，甚至能让一个27B模型超越一个2.8T参数模型的单次成功率。

articles.title: Two Birds with One Stone: Skill-Augmented Generation via Unified Retrieval and Utilization
articles.abstract: Skills, as reusable external knowledge, have demonstrated substantial potential to enhance the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks. However, existing skill-augmented generation methods typically rely on separate models for skill retrieval and skill utilization, resulting in disconnected optimization of these two processes. To address this gap, we propose Skill-Uni, a unified reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes skill retrieval and utilization. Specifically, we adopt a generative skill retrieval paradigm that enables a single model to both learn how to retrieve relevant skills and leverage them for task solving. To effectively train this unified framework, we introduce a two-stage training strategy consisting of warm-up instruction tuning and GRPO, allowing the model to progressively improve its skill retrieval and utilization capabilities. Extensive experiments on five skill-related benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Skill-Uni, yielding average performance gains of 66.59% and 34.82% over the base Qwen3-4B and LLaMA3.1-8B models, respectively. Besides, Skill-Uni is compatible with various skill retrieval engines, demonstrating its flexibility and generalizability. Additional in-depth analyses also provide insights into the effectiveness of Skill-Uni.
articles.titleCn: 一石二鸟：通过统一检索与利用实现技能增强生成
articles.abstractCn: 技能作为一种可重用的外部知识，已展现出显著潜力，能够提升大型语言模型（LLM）解决复杂任务的能力。然而，现有的技能增强生成方法通常依赖独立的模型进行技能检索和技能利用，导致这两个过程优化脱节。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了Skill-Uni，一个统一强化学习框架，该框架联合优化技能检索和技能利用。具体而言，我们采用生成式技能检索范式，使单个模型能够同时学习如何检索相关技能，并利用这些技能解决任务。为有效训练这一统一框架，我们引入了两阶段训练策略，包括预热指令微调和GRPO，使模型逐步提升其技能检索和技能利用能力。在五个技能相关基准测试上的大量实验表明了Skill-Uni的有效性，相较于基础Qwen3-4B和LLaMA3.1-8B模型，平均性能分别提升了66.59%和34.82%。此外，Skill-Uni兼容多种技能检索引擎，展现了其灵活性和泛化能力。更深入的分析也揭示了Skill-Uni的有效性。

articles.title: Component Translation and Judge-Labelled Refusal: A Multilingual Safety Evaluation
articles.abstract: Whole-prompt translation evaluates a request in different languages but does not compare which component carries a language. We introduce a paired reversal: translate the complete request component or the complete operation component into the same target language, holding behaviour, English frame and translated-span count fixed. Component identity and non-English text quantity change together. Assigning English, Chinese and Spanish independently to the two components yields nine configurations on 190 of 300 sampled harmful behaviours retained after consensus annotation and automatic gating. Refusal scored by language-model judges is the primary outcome; unsafe compliance is reported separately. On Gemini 2.5 Flash and DeepSeek, three refusal swaps are about 5.3 percentage points and the fourth is -0.5; none survives the pre-specified six-test Holm correction. In an exploratory extension, Mistral Small 4 has a 13.7-point Spanish swap (95% interval [8.4, 18.9]), which survives the twelve-test Holm sensitivity correction under the primary judge, and 12.1 points under a second judge. GPT-5.4-mini estimates are within 2 points of zero. Component assignment supplies an additional evaluation dimension. Evaluations should record component languages and translated text quantity, comparing matched behaviours at equal translated-span count while interpreting refusal and unsafe compliance separately.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Ten-page manuscript prepared for the 4th Workshop on Large Language and Foundation Models (WLLFM 2026) at IEEE BigData 2026, plus appendices A-E. Replication archive included as ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 组件翻译与裁判标注拒绝：多语言安全评估
articles.abstractCn: 整体提示翻译评估不同语言中的请求，但不会比较哪个部分承载语言。我们引入了一种配对反转：将完整请求部分或完整操作部分翻译成同一目标语言，保持行为、英语框架和翻译跨度数量不变。组件身份和非英语文本数量共同变化。独立地为两个组件分配英语、中文和西班牙语，在共识标注和自动门控后保留下来的300个样本中有190个有害行为产生了九种配置。语言模型评委给出的拒绝评分是主要结果；不安全顺从单独报告。在Gemini 2.5 Flash和DeepSeek上，三个拒绝交换约为5.3个百分点，第四个为-0.5；没有一个通过预设的六次测试Holm校正。在探索性扩展中，Mistral Small 4有一个13.7个百分点的西班牙语交换（95%区间[8.4, 18.9]），在主要评委下通过十二次测试Holm敏感性校正，在第二个评委下为12.1点。GPT-5.4-mini的估计值在零的2个百分点以内。组件分配提供了一个额外的评估维度。评估应记录组件语言和翻译文本数量，在相同翻译跨度数量下比较匹配行为，同时分别解释拒绝和不安全顺从。

articles.title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
articles.abstract: We present EasyProver, a Lean proving system built from recursive agents with isolated contexts, asynchronous search, parallel tactic probing, and an elastic elaboration service. Using an off-the-shelf frontier model with no additional training, it proves 669/672 PutnamBench problems and all six IMO 2026 formalizations and resolves 597/600 NTP4VC verification conditions and all 189 VERINA tasks by proof or refutation. Because these benchmarks are close to saturation, we also introduce Aegis, which converts competitive programming problems into much harder verification tasks over real implementations. The pipeline writes safe Rust solutions, translates them into Lean with Aeneas, generates specifications, and labels each frozen statement with a kernel-checked proof or refutation. It produces 2,045 differentially validated Rust-Lean program pairs and 11,533 candidate specifications. Unlike hand-written benchmarks, these tasks carry implementation-level obligations from fixed-width arithmetic, explicit failure, generated loops, casts, and functionalized mutation. On a stratified sample of 2,000 statements, EasyProver proves 1,054 (52.7%) within a 30-minute budget per statement. The same tasks can also be used to benchmark other provers and as rewards for reinforcement learning.
articles.titleCn: 面向真实世界代码验证的精益规模化定理证明
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了EasyProver，这是一个由具有隔离上下文的递归代理、异步搜索、并行战术探测和弹性展开服务构建的Lean证明系统。使用现成的边界模型且无需额外训练，它证明了669/672个PutnamBench问题以及所有六个IMO 2026形式化，并通过证明或反驳解决了597/600个NTP4VC验证条件和所有189个VERINA任务。由于这些基准测试接近饱和，我们还引入了Aegis，它将竞赛编程问题转换为关于真实实现的远更困难的验证任务。该流水线生成安全的Rust解决方案，使用Aeneas将其翻译成Lean，生成规范，并为每个冻结语句标记经过内核检查的证明或反驳。它生成了2,045对差分验证的Rust-Lean程序和11,533个候选规范。与手写的基准测试不同，这些任务从固定宽度算术、显式失败、生成的循环、类型转换和函数化的变异中携带了实现级别的义务。在一个分层样本的2,000个语句中，EasyProver在每条语句30分钟的预算内证明了1,054条（52.7%）。相同的任务也可以用于基准测试其他证明器，以及作为强化学习的奖励。

articles.title: ATI-OPD: Adaptive Teacher Intervention for Stable Long-Sequence On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses using token-level feedback from a teacher. As responses grow longer, the student's prefix can depart from the teacher's own reasoning, weakening its feedback on later tokens. Updates based on this feedback can reinforce the same deviations in later responses and destabilize training. Prior approaches such as length control and loss reweighting limit learning from problematic responses but leave their prefixes unchanged. Fixed cutoffs can also discard later reasoning. We propose \textbf{Adaptive Teacher Intervention for On-Policy Distillation (ATI-OPD)} to improve subsequent teacher guidance by revising the student's reasoning prefix. ATI-OPD replaces the earliest high-disagreement segment with a short teacher segment, then lets the student resume its own reasoning from the revised text. To handle renewed disagreement, it excludes persistently divergent suffixes from the distillation loss while retaining useful student continuation. Training diagnostics show less teacher-student disagreement, fewer gradient spikes, and fewer extremely long responses. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two teacher-student pairs, ATI-OPD improves average student-only accuracy over standard OPD.
articles.titleCn: ATI-OPD：用于稳定长序列在线策略蒸馏的自适应教师干预
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过教师提供的标记级反馈来训练学生模型，使用其自身的响应。随着响应变长，学生的前缀可能偏离教师自身的推理，从而削弱其对后续标记的反馈效果。基于这种反馈的更新可能会在后续响应中强化相同的偏差，导致训练不稳定。先前方法如长度控制和损失重加权虽然限制了从问题响应中学习，但保留了其前缀不变。固定的截断点也可能丢弃后续的推理。我们提出了\textbf{自适应教师干预策略内蒸馏（ATI-OPD）}，通过修改学生的推理前缀来改进后续的教师指导。ATI-OPD用一段简短的教师响应替换最早的高分歧片段，然后让学生从修改后的文本中继续自己的推理。为了处理重新出现的分歧，它将持续偏离的后缀排除在蒸馏损失之外，同时保留有用的学生延续部分。训练诊断显示教师与学生之间的分歧减少，梯度尖峰减少，以及极端长响应减少。在五个数学推理基准和两个师生对中，ATI-OPD在标准OPD基础上提高了学生单独的平均准确率。

articles.title: Calculation and rejection diverge in language models tested at known mechanical limits
articles.abstract: When a language model returns engineering quantities with the status "solved", software that trusts it passes them on, even when the requested design is physically impossible. Such failures could reflect poor calculation, how the answer is requested, or a failure to judge feasibility. We set beam loads and disk speeds at known percentages above or below plastic collapse or burst, measured each model's limit calculation separately and tested 12 models in 4,860 calls, including follow-up experiments on new designs. We find that a model can recognize an impossible design when asked only whether it is feasible, yet accept the same design, reporting "solved", when asked for a full answer. Three models accepted beams 10 to 30% beyond collapse despite precise limit calculations in separate questions, and many accepted replies stated the violation. Asked only about feasibility, Opus 5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash rejected every impossible new design they were given, including those accepted in full answers, without false alarms. Rewording when to decline or changing the answer format raised rejection on the original beams, but not consistently on new designs. Software and benchmarks using a model's status should test feasibility judgment and full-answer rejection separately, and report the exact prompt.
articles.comment: 94 pages, including Supplementary Information. Data and code: https://github.com/nbbllxx0/Certified-feasibility-margins
articles.titleCn: 在已知机械极限下测试的语言模型中，计算与拒绝出现分歧
articles.abstractCn: 当语言模型返回状态为“已解决”的工程量时，信任它的软件会继续传递这些数据，即使所请求的设计在物理上是不可能实现的。此类错误可能反映计算失误、提问方式不当或可行性判断失败。我们设定了梁载荷和磁盘速度，使其高于或低于塑性坍塌或爆裂的已知百分比，分别测量每个模型的极限计算，并在4,860次调用中测试了12个模型，包括对新设计的后续实验。我们发现，当仅询问其可行性时，模型能够识别不可能的设计，但在要求完整答案时，却会接受相同的设计并报告“已解决”。三个模型接受了超出坍塌10%至30%的梁，尽管在单独的问题中进行了精确的极限计算，并且许多接受的回答中明确指出了违规行为。仅询问可行性时，Opus 5和Gemini 3.8 Flash拒绝了他们所给出的所有不可能的新设计，包括在完整答案中被接受的设计，且没有误报。重写拒绝时机或改变答案格式会导致对原始梁的拒绝，但对新设计并非始终如此。使用模型状态进行软件和基准测试时，应分别测试可行性判断和完整答案拒绝，并报告确切的提示。

articles.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
articles.abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.
articles.titleCn: Nemotron 3.5 Super 和 Lightning：面向自主式人工智能的开源、高效专家混合 Mamba-Transformer 混合模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Nemotron 3.5 Super和Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，这两种开放且高效的专家混合Mamba-Transformer模型，专为推理、长上下文理解以及代理式工作负载而设计。Super是一款拥有1200亿参数、120亿活跃参数的多模态模型，而Lightning则是一款参数量更小的300亿参数、30亿活跃参数的文本模型，两者均设计用于高效部署。这两个模型结合了大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练和原生推测解码，而Super进一步融入了印度语持续预训练和代理式软件工程中途训练。我们开发了一套全面的后续训练流程，涵盖监督微调和强化学习（RLVR和RLHF），并在Super中通过专门的教师训练和多教师策略蒸馏（MOPD）进行补充。这使得Super从一个纯文本基础模型转变为能够对文本、图像、视频和交互式工具环境进行推理的多模态代理。我们进一步探索了测试时扩展，通过并行代理执行和自我验证。在训练和部署过程中，我们联合优化了能力和效率。印度语持续预训练将印度语言基准提升了高达9.82个百分点，而代理式中途训练增强了软件工程能力和代理 harness 的鲁棒性。后续训练的Super模型在SWE-bench Pro上达到了51.78%的成绩，尽管使用的活跃参数量仅约为Nemotron 3 Ultra的4.6倍，却超越了后者。后续训练的多任务提升（MTP boosting）在概率草稿采样下将推测解码的接受长度提升了高达21.8%，而NVFP4量化相对于BF16实现了99.62%的中值精度恢复。推理优化使得在GB200上实现了高达4856输出token/s/GPU的性能，同时至少维持了50 tokens/s/user的速率。
